history.summary: A 2,336 sqft 4BR at Pasir Ris (D18) for $2.98M — near the top of the price band where the buyer pool thins sharply, with no MRT walkable. Solid 5.81% appreciation on 211 txns and a below-median $1,276 psf are positives, but the quantum and far-flung location make exit risk the dominant concern.
history.rating_rationale: Resale-only 5.81%/yr on 211 txns is genuinely strong and the $1,276 psf is ~11% under the $1,431 median, so on fundamentals it screens well. But $2.98M is right at the >$3M threshold where the buyer pool shrinks, this is a 2,336 sqft 4BR (family-only, niche), and the blank MRT field on a far-eastern Pasir Ris site means weak transit support. Tampines CRL/DTL and the broader east narrative help, but the quantum + exit-liquidity risk on a large OCR unit balances the strong appreciation to Neutral.

2,336 sqft 4BR = narrow family-only buyer pool, slow exit
catalysts: Resale-only 5.81%/yr on a deep 211-txn series — reliable and above OCR baseline
Pasir Ris/Tampines regional growth, CRL+DTL connectivity in the wider area

history.summary: Modestly cheap OCR 1BR in Pasir Ris with a real but distance-limited CRL catalyst. Asking $1,365 psf is below the ~$1,432 12-mo average, region is favourable, but the nearest MRT is far and finishing reviews are mixed.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,365 psf vs a verified 12-mo project average ~$1,432 psf (range $1,223-$1,721) is a genuine ~5% discount, supported by age_adj_premium -11.3% and psf_premium_vs_cohort -2.8% on a respectable base (appreciation_txns=211, psf_cohort_txns=25). OCR aligns with the strongest v3.4 forward bracket. The Pasir Ris East CRL station (CR2-area, ~2030) is a confirmed catalyst for the broader area. The discount is modest rather than dramatic, the current nearest MRT (Pasir Ris EW1) is ~22-min walk, and resident reviews flag weak interior finishing — so this is a value-plus-catalyst Buy, not a Strong Buy. Lower confidence than Affinity because the cheapness margin is smaller and the catalyst is less proximate.
red_flags: Nearest existing MRT (Pasir Ris EW1) ~22-min walk — poor current connectivity
Resident reviews describe interior finishing as poor/impractical
Discount to cohort is only ~5% — modest margin of safety
catalysts: Pasir Ris East MRT (Cross-Island Line), targeted ~2030 — area connectivity uplift
OCR location aligns with v3.4 best-realized-forward-return bracket
Sub-$840k entry in the far east keeps the price accessible for resale and rental

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Pasir Ris draws Changi/Loyang industrial and airport tenants; a 614sqft 1BR under $840k should achieve a sound gross yield, though the distance to MRT caps tenant pool until CRL opens.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Trailing 5.81% CAGR (211 txns) is healthy but I treat it as story not forward guarantee. The forward thesis leans on the modest verified discount and the 2030 CRL re-rating; both credible but less decisive than a 4-min-walk catalyst.
